'''Yumas''' are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are gelatinous coral drifters, long lost to time and living on only in memory.
== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Yuma is a docile creature and poses no threat to [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]. It simply floats in the air, dealing no damage if coming into contact with Hornet.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* The crust covers...
* The crust conceals...
* Our shells made strong...
* Our nest made secret...
}}

== Location ==
Yumas can only be found in [[Crust King Khann]]'s [[Elegy of the Deep|Memory]] of the [[Coral Tower]] during [[Acts|Act 3]].
